spec.title: India - Total Confirmed Cases
spec.description: Historical cumulative confirmed COVID-19 cases in India, from 30 January 2020 to 31 October 2021.

spec.query: SELECT mean("confirmed") FROM "india_national" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT LAST("recovered")
FROM "india_state"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY "State"

SELECT SUM("daily_confirmed")
FROM "india_national"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)

spec.title: Global - Daily New Cases by Country

spec.query:
SELECT LAST("confirmed")
FROM "global_covid"
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND "location" =~ /^${country:regex}$/
GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)

SELECT LAST("deaths")
FROM "global_covid"
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND "location" =~ /^${country:regex}$/
GROUP BY time(1d) fill(null)

spec.title: India - Total Deaths
spec.description: Historical cumulative COVID-19 deaths in India, Jan 2020–Oct 2021

spec.query:
SELECT LAST("confirmed")
FROM "global_covid"
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND "location" = '$country'
GROUP BY "location"

spec.title: COVID-19 Confirmed Cases by Indian State

spec.query:
SELECT LAST("confirmed")
FROM "india_state"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY "State"

SELECT LAST("deaths")
FROM "india_state"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY "State"
